title: [review] provisioning.py:433: encode() failure after su
description: At line 433, if ack.encode() raises (e.g., cbor2 serialization error) after on_new_identity callback succeeded at line 424, the callback side-effects (identity storage) persist but the response fails. The session is not wiped because the exception propagates before _remove_session(). A retry would call the callback again, potentially duplicating the stored identity if the callback is not idempotent.
